missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Существование' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Жизни' is genitive of possession, and 'возможно' is the predicate.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Существование' is the inanimate neuter accusative object of 'доказали', identical to the nominative. 'Планеты' is the genitive of possession.

missions.phrase: Они не верят в существование души.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'В существование' uses the accusative after 'в' with 'верить'. 'Души' is the genitive of possession.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Существования' takes the genitive in the absence construction with 'нет'. 'Доказательств' is also genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Благодаря существованию' uses the dative after 'благодаря' to show the cause. 'Воды' is the genitive of possession.
Strategic focus: Instrumental complement. 'Существованием' is the instrumental required by 'интересоваться'. 'Человека' is the genitive of possession.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В существовании' uses the prepositional after 'в' with 'сомневаться'. 'Бога' is the genitive of possession.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Существование' is the neuter nominative subject. 'Без цели' uses the genitive after 'без', and 'бессмысленно' is the predicate.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Существования' is the inanimate neuter accusative plural object of 'обсуждают', here meaning modes of existence. 'Миров' is genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Существование' is nominative as the predicate noun. 'Сложное' and 'философское' are agreeing neuter adjectives.
